notes.title: Version update!
notes.content:
《休闲拼一拼》Finally ushered in the first major version update. I would like to thank all players for their silent support behind it. This is my second independent game. There are still many shortcomings, which will be made up in the later version.

New UI interface

The new UI interface is more ornamental and interactive, bringing a new experience.

Added language selection

English interface switching is added in this version.

Increase difficulty selection

You can challenge your limits in different difficulties, and you can also compete with your friends in different difficulties.

Add gold coin system

The increase or decrease of gold coins obtained during the puzzle can be used to unlock the next puzzle.
